calibration.prompt: the eleventh month of the year is

design: Five independent seeded shuffles of the same 15 ordinary words; no model-output-based selection.
Within each requested ordinal, all five expected answers differ; ordinal 11 is not the final list item.
Numbered/bullet formats use exactly the same word orders.
Thirty pilot cases: five lists x two formats x requested positions 5/11/12. All failures and zeros retained.
Native BF16 model; FP32 read-only T2375 observer before layer-29 post-attention RMSNorm; native MLP is retained.
Every case runs unhooked and with the observer; all generated tokens and every logits hash must match exactly.
Activation belongs to the token being processed, which supplies the next-token prediction.
One extra read-only forward after decoding traces the final generated token, including EOS; it does not add a generated token. Its unused logits are checked against the unhooked pass.
Separate raw eleventh-month calibration checks measurement location and positive activation; excluded from pilot accuracy.
No gate edits, steering, ablation, contribution replacement, or MLP replacement.
Primary accuracy is EOS-terminated word-only response after case/punctuation normalization. First-listed-word accuracy is also reported separately.
List-prefix activations precede the question; they cannot establish dependence on a later ordinal request.
